description: ControlThings ctmodbus read and discovery operations for authorized Modbus (TCP/UDP/RTU/ASCII) assessment.
purpose: Enumerate Modbus devices, read registers, coils and device identification in authorized OT/ICS labs.
use_cases: Detection validation for industrial protocol operations.
prerequisites: Authorized OT/ICS test target or simulator.
safety_notes: All write/modify operations alter device state. Use only against authorized test targets.
Never target production OT/ICS systems without written authorization and change controls.
author: Justin Searle / ControlThings / X3M.AI integration

tag_categories.label: ControlThings Modbus
tag_categories.description: Modbus target, transport, and operation parameters.

assets.name: controlthings-modbus-runner
assets.description: Morgana non-interactive wrapper for ctmodbus operations. Requires ctmodbus Python package.

scripts.name: CONTROLTHINGS - MODBUS - Read Device Identification
scripts.description: ControlThings ctmodbus: Read Device Identification. Targets Modbus TCP devices in authorized OT/ICS lab environments.
scripts.command:
# ControlThings Modbus — FC43 Read Device ID (TCP)
# Uses ctmodbus Python API via Morgana runner wrapper
# All interactions are with an explicitly authorized OT/ICS lab target

RUNNER='{{asset:controlthings_modbus_runner}}'

# Validate target
case "#{ct_modbus_target}" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9._:-]*) echo "[ERROR] Invalid target" >&2; exit 2;; esac

# Connect and execute
python3 "$RUNNER" ctmodbus connect_tcp "#{ct_modbus_target}:#{ct_modbus_port}"
python3 "$RUNNER" ctmodbus unit_id "#{ct_modbus_unit_id}"
python3 "$RUNNER" ctmodbus # unknown operation: read-device-id
python3 "$RUNNER" ctmodbus close

echo "MORGANA_RESULT_METADATA={\"provider\":\"controlthings\",\"component\":\"ctmodbus\",\"operation\":\"read-device-id\",\"transport\":\"tcp\",\"status\":\"completed\"}"
